summary: Full frontend e2e playthrough of Lucy's Tech Trivia Game via Playwright. Verified start screen gating, 10-question flow with per-question progress/score/timer/feedback, deterministic score (5/10 after 5 correct + 5 wrong), auto-advance after reveal, results screen content, and Play Again reset. All data-testid selectors present and functional. No backend to test.
critical_code_review_comments: useTriviaGame hook: logic is clean, timers correctly cleaned up with clearTimeout. REVEAL_DELAY_MS=3000 and QUESTION_TIME=30 match spec.
Timeout path (no selection) correctly triggers reveal(null) and shows 'Time's up!' feedback (verified by code review; not exercised in test to save time).
All interactive and informational elements expose data-testid attributes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only trivia game. Correct answer indices (0-based): [1,0,2,2,1,2,0,1,0,2]. Full playthrough works deterministically. Only area not exercised live was the 30s timeout path (verified by code inspection only).
